target_customer: Founders and operators at growing companies
problem: People, teams, roles and ownership are tracked across org charts, Notion, spreadsheets and Slack and must be reworked after every change.

founders.name: Adam Suskin
founders.background_notes: Over five years as engineering lead; tech lead for a US Army deployment converting an 823M USD contract vehicle, per YC page.

technical_complexity.rationale: Graph and org-structure visualization with integrations is standard SaaS engineering; no research-grade component evidenced.

defensibility.rationale: Becoming the system of record for org structure could create lock-in, but HRIS vendors can add similar views.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Not established; no source on incumbent responses. Incumbent names come from retrieved ChartHop alternatives lists (2026), not dated at founding.

market_need_then: Company describes fragmented tracking of org structure; no dated demand evidence retrieved.

brand_strength.rationale: Real word that is memorable but unrelated to org charts; no sources on brand impact. Tagline 'the living map of your organization'.

outcome_analysis: Crouton is an active four-person Fall 2024 company with a single founder who has Palantir engineering experience. No funding, customer or outcome information was found publicly, so its trajectory cannot be assessed beyond being active per the YC directory.
notes: Funding search returned only an unrelated company (Living Map); no round recorded. StartupHub says founded 2022 in San Francisco versus YC (2024, New York); YC used.
